data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, my recommendation would be **Stripe**, unless you're using Shopify, in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best processor depends on your website platform, transaction volume and the types of customers you serve. You don't necessarily need the biggest payment company – you need one that's affordable, reliable and easy to integrate.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Straightforward setup and integration.
- Accepts debit cards, credit cards and digital wallets.
- Good fraud prevention and reporting.
- No standard monthly gateway fee.
- Indicative UK domestic card rate: 1.5% + 20p.

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway needed.
- Simple refunds and order management.
- Rates depend on your Shopify subscription.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognised and trusted by many customers.
- Offers PayPal wallet checkout as well as card options.
- Useful for international customers.
- Can be more expensive than alternatives.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Good if you sell online and in person.
- Online store and payment links available.
- Straightforward management.
- Indicative UK online domestic card rate: 1.4% + 25p.

Website: [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![Mollie pinautomaat kosten (2026) · gratis vergelijken](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D57_7d7oSy02s6yl1zjAav-Yxgf4LUZZPYDHYzFt_wNqCHlBqkrhAHplhYfBTJOJy91u1bEQYVbEZXh_gEzRP8VoyGIrNDZVtuNQGJCvwJQrSLcgSZ7d7a0ve45WpqW-VHK_GV5JgM8myiK1AujLCh4qHlURg2gBe2EoWYpui5Qphgo8QfSPgrRjtevRCmLH?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Mollie**

- Worth considering for UK and European customers.
- Supports various local payment methods.
- Competitive card-processing rates.
- Particularly interesting for European-focused stores.

Website: [Mollie](https://www.mollie.com/)

Indicative UK rates, not guaranteed quotes. Actual fees depend on card type, payment method, subscription and international transactions. ## What I would choose

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Using WordPress / WooCommerce | Stripe |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Selling throughout Europe | Mollie |
| Want customers to have PayPal | Add PayPal alongside your main processor |


**One important tip\:** You can offer Stripe and PayPal together. This gives customers more choice and can help reduce abandoned checkouts.
